summary: The session discusses the evolution of data engineering for AI, highlighting the differences between traditional data management and AI-specific data engineering practices. It emphasizes the importance of data readiness, governance, and collaboration between data and AI teams to ensure successful AI use cases. The speaker shares insights from a survey of organizations already investing in AI, outlining key practices for achieving business outcomes.

sections.topic: Introduction to Data Engineering for AI
key_points: Understanding the differences between data for AI and data for humans
Challenges in data availability and quality for AI use cases

sections.topic: Key Questions in AI Data Engineering
key_points: Identifying use cases and AI techniques
Assessing data availability and quality requirements
Governance policies and their role in data representativeness

sections.topic: Collaboration Between Data and AI Teams
key_points: Reuse of data across different AI use cases
Key drivers for delivering business value with AI

key_takeaways: Ensure data readiness assessments are integral to your AI program.
Foster collaboration between data management and AI teams to enhance data quality.
Leverage existing data products to support multiple AI use cases efficiently.
